name: Champions4good
mood: midnight sports broadside on a plum-dark wall
summary: A dark sports club broadside style with Deep Plum canvas, Lavender Shock accent, oversized Druk Condensed poster type, quiet Neue Montreal UI text, pill sport toggles, compact lavender actions, soft cards, and high-contrast white section breaks.

layout.model: full-bleed plum broadside sections, transparent nav, pill sport toggles, huge left-aligned display words, and Paper White contrast breaks

elevation.depth: flat color layering, surface contrast, and typographic scale

dos: Use Druk Condensed for all display headings at 58px or larger.
Set display type to line-height 0.78 to 0.85.
Use Lavender Shock as the only major chromatic color on Deep Plum sections.
Apply 9999px radius to buttons, tags, and pill elements.
Break the page rhythm with Paper White sections after dark plum sections.
Use Mint Signal and Amber Pulse only as small punctuation.
Keep Neue Montreal at 12px to 16px for UI chrome.
donts: Do not use any font other than a condensed poster face for display type.
Do not place Lavender Shock on white or light backgrounds.
Do not add box shadows to cards or buttons.
Do not use line-height above 1.0 for display type.
Do not mix mint and amber into dark plum sections as major surfaces.
Do not use border radius smaller than 6px on interactive elements.
